experiment: Feature set ranking changes under temporal split
finding: CRITICAL: System rankings change when switching from random CV to temporal split
key_insight: Features that improve random CV performance (q_value, use_count, days_since) actually HURT temporal generalization. The best feature set under temporal split is the simplest one (metadata only), suggesting that complex features overfit to temporal patterns that do not generalize.
implication: Published rankings based on random CV may be incorrect. Cross-system comparisons using random CV should be re-evaluated using temporal splits.
